title: Obama's Area 51 remark, later walked back
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Obama's Area 51 remark, later walked back, about 2026 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. And Obama sort of walked his statement back. He talked about Area 51 and alien beings underground there.
The very next day, he had to buy it back.

tellings.link_reason: Obama walking back his aliens and Area 51 remark is the same event as this story.

as_told.title: Obama walks back the aliens remark; Trump takes the bait

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says that in 2026 Barack Obama, the former US president, spoke about Area 51, a secret US military test base in the Nevada desert long linked to UFO stories, and about alien beings kept underground there. Michels says Obama then walked his statement back. A guest named Bryce says the walk-back came the very next day, and that Donald Trump took the bait. If true, it would mean a former president briefly hinted at something he then had to take back.
